title: Replication and leader-follower setups

kcs.statement: Replication keeps copies of the same data on several nodes so the data survives a node loss and read load can be spread across copies.
In leader-follower replication all writes go to one leader, which streams its changes to followers that serve reads; read capacity grows with followers but write capacity stays that of one node.
When the leader of a leader-follower setup dies, writes stop until a follower is promoted to leader and clients are redirected to it.
